name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Exactly one of these is true: Anders goes with 15 ly; Okafor goes with Lumen; Europa goes with 14 ly.
The colonist in the Echo module's distance is at least 2 ly more than the colonist from Luna.
Europa, Luna, and Titan go with Cho, 14 ly, and 15 ly, in some order.
If Forge does not go with 13 ly, then Okafor goes with 13 ly.
